{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {trial['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(trial)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(trial) - trial['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for sample_seq per patient_id
sample_seq_counts = trial.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Maximum sample_seq per patient: {sample_seq_counts.max()}")

# Check how many patients have multiple sample_seq
multiple_tests = sample_seq_counts[sample_seq_counts > 1].count()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {multiple_tests}")"}
